caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional figurine of a stout man standing on a brown rectangular base. The man is shown in profile facing to the right, wearing a large brown hat, a yellow jacket with prominent buttons, and light grayish trousers. His hands are clasped behind his back, and he has a pipe with a brown bowl and black stem in his mouth. His face is plump with visible cheekbones, and he has brown hair combed to the side. The jacket's collar is shown as white, and there is a hint of a red necktie or scarf visible at the front. The color palette consists primarily of shades of brown, yellow, gray, and some muted reds and whites. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present.
